title: Stable-ASR Data Source Registry
description: Dataset and transcript-source registry for reproducible real-time ASR, turn-taking, endpointing, and full-duplex voice-agent experiments.

sources.title: Stable-ASR Synthetic VoiceWorld
sources.notes: Seedable synthetic turn/action scenarios used for smoke tests and paper artifact shape.

sources.title: Easy Turn-style manifests
sources.notes: Four-state turn-taking style data converted into the Stable-ASR turn manifest.

sources.title: Full-Duplex-Bench-style manifests
sources.notes: Overlap and full-duplex interaction cases converted into the Stable-ASR turn manifest.

sources.title: Smart Turn-style manifests
sources.notes: Turn completion probability rows converted into turn/action labels.

sources.title: Whisper-style transcript exports
sources.notes: Segments and word timestamps normalized into StreamingASRRecord JSONL.

sources.title: FunASR-style transcript exports
sources.notes: Sentence/timestamp rows normalized into StreamingASRRecord JSONL.

sources.title: Vendor ASR transcript exports
sources.notes: Command-backed transcript exports from modern ASR systems normalized into StreamingASRRecord JSONL.

sources.title: LibriSpeech
sources.notes: Canonical English ASR corpus; v0 provides metadata normalization before future MiniASR training recipes.

sources.title: AISHELL-1
sources.notes: Mandarin ASR corpus; v0 provides metadata normalization before future Chinese ASR recipes.

sources.title: WenetSpeech
sources.notes: Large Mandarin ASR source; v0 normalizes local metadata exports for later scaling experiments.

sources.title: Common Voice
sources.notes: Multilingual source; v0 normalizes local metadata exports for accent and cross-language robustness experiments.
